questions.cardText:
[Botany] Why do blueberries look blue?
A. Due to their natural sugars
B. Because of anthocyanins
C. Due to their waxy coating
Answer: C. Blueberries appear blue because of a structural coloration caused by the waxy coating on their surface. This is similar to how some bird feathers get their colors, not from pigments, but from microscopic structures that reflect specific wavelengths of light.
questions.de: Die Hautpigmente der Heidelbeere sind dunkelrot – was auf ihrer Oberfläche lässt sie blau erscheinen, indem es blaues und ultraviolettes Licht streut?
questions.en: Blueberries' skin pigment is dark red — what on their surface makes them look blue, by scattering blue and ultraviolet light?

timeline.labelEn: Bristol researchers show in Science Advances that blueberries' blue comes from their wax coating, not pigment
timeline.labelDe: Forscher aus Bristol zeigen in Science Advances, dass das Blau der Heidelbeere von ihrer Wachsschicht stammt, nicht von Pigmenten

source.title: Scientists reveal why blueberries are blue

questions.notes: Card is correct (Middleton et al., Science Advances, 7 Feb 2024): the wax's disordered nanostructures scatter blue/UV; the skin's anthocyanin pigment is dark red.

questions.cardText:
[Architecture] What is the architectural style of the Chrysler Building in New York City?
A. Art Deco
B. Gothic Revival
C. Neoclassical
Answer: A. The Chrysler Building is a quintessential example of Art Deco architecture, featuring decorative metalwork and a distinctive spire.
questions.de: In welchem Architekturstil ist das Chrysler Building in New York mit seinen Metallverzierungen und seiner markanten Turmspitze erbaut?
questions.en: In which architectural style is the Chrysler Building in New York City, with its decorative metalwork and distinctive spire, built?

timeline.labelEn: The Art Deco Chrysler Building opens in Manhattan, briefly the world's tallest building
timeline.labelDe: Das Art-déco-Hochhaus Chrysler Building wird in Manhattan eröffnet und ist kurz das höchste Gebäude der Welt
